system.description: You move much farther than normal in a round. When using Fleet of Foot, all distances you move are doubled. If you run a long distance as your entire action, all your tasks are hindered by one step until the end of your next turn (instead of two steps). As a Last action, you can run up to 500 feet (150 m), but all your tasks are hindered by two steps until the end of your next turn. Enabler.
